core_question: Did the state respect protect and fulfill rights without discrimination
legal_significance: Creates duties of prevention protection investigation punishment remedy and structural reform
example_context: Domestic violence harmful practices reproductive coercion policing failures

core_question: Is violence connected to discrimination stereotypes or unequal institutions
legal_significance: Treats gender-based violence as discrimination and requires substantive equality
example_context: State tolerance of violence unequal family law access to justice barriers

core_question: Does a regional treaty or court provide a stronger procedural path
legal_significance: May provide binding judgments specific violence instruments and regional due diligence doctrine
example_context: Belém do Pará Istanbul Convention Maputo Protocol

core_question: Did the harm occur in armed conflict or affect protected persons
legal_significance: Regulates violence detention dignity sexual violence and protection during conflict
example_context: Conflict-related sexual violence displacement detention checkpoints

core_question: Does the conduct satisfy war crime crime against humanity genocide persecution or command responsibility elements
legal_significance: Creates individual criminal responsibility for atrocity crimes
example_context: Sexual slavery forced pregnancy rape persecution forced marriage

core_question: Does feared harm amount to persecution connected to a protected ground where state protection is unavailable
example_context: Forced marriage trafficking domestic violence anti-LGBTQ persecution

core_question: Was exploitation produced through force coercion deception abuse of vulnerability or abuse of power
legal_significance: Requires identification protection non-punishment investigation and remedy
example_context: Sexual exploitation forced labor domestic servitude forced marriage

core_question: Did violence harassment or exploitation occur in the world of work
legal_significance: Connects gendered harm to workplace safety equality and labor regulation
example_context: Harassment migrant domestic work supply chains informal labor
